import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df.account_id=='S5Tfd67'].copy()
def sortkey(d):
    m,dd,y = d.split('/')
    return (int(y), int(m), int(dd))
sub['d'] = sub.date.map(sortkey)
# baseline: mean of all other days per resource group (csp, cloud_service, application, instance_family)
g = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
anom_date = (2025,10,16)
other = sub[sub.d != anom_date]
anom = sub[sub.d == anom_date]
base = other.groupby(g)['unblended_cost'].agg(['mean','std','count']).reset_index()
anom_g = anom.groupby(g)['unblended_cost'].sum().reset_index().rename(columns={'unblended_cost':'anom'})
m = base.merge(anom_g, on=g, how='outer')
m['anom'] = m.anom.fillna(0)
m['diff'] = m.anom - m.mean
m['z'] = np.where(m.std>0, m.diff/m.std, 0)
m = m.sort_values('diff', ascending=False)
print(m.head(15).to_string())

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df.account_id=='S5Tfd67'].copy()
def sortkey(d):
    m,dd,y = d.split('/')
    return (int(y), int(m), int(dd))
sub['d'] = sub.date.map(sortkey)
# baseline: mean of all other days per resource group (csp, cloud_service, application, instance_family)
g = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
anom_date = (2025,10,16)
other = sub[sub.d != anom_date]
anom = sub[sub.d == anom_date]
base = other.groupby(g)['unblended_cost'].agg(['mean','std','count']).reset_index()
anom_g = anom.groupby(g)['unblended_cost'].sum().reset_index().rename(columns={'unblended_cost':'anom'})
m = base.merge(anom_g, on=g, how='outer')
m['anom'] = m.anom.fillna(0)
m['diff'] = m.anom - m.mean
m['z'] = np.where(m.std>0, m.diff/m.std, 0)
m = m.sort_values('diff', ascending=False)
print(m.head(15).to_string())
"}
